caption:
A missed call doesn't have to mean a lost job.

The moment the phone rings and no one picks up, the caller already pulls up the next number. Calling back later isn't the fix. A text sent within 5 minutes is.

Copy this and send it after every missed call:

"Sorry we missed you. This is [Business]. What do you need help with today?"

No reply in 10 minutes? Follow with your booking link.

The business that answers first gets the job. The other one loses it before the estimate even starts.

Want every missed call handled like this, automatically?

rationale: Script-reveal reels win completion and saves for B2B teaching right now, and this hands over the exact word-for-word missed-call text, distinct from every prior ring-group, sending-number, and voicemail-timing angle already shipped.
